digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter transport and retry layer
propositions: 429 responses with Retry-After headers must be retried on opted-in idempotent read operations, with jitter applied and delay clamped to MAX_BACKOFF_S

The rate_limit_retry flag must be threaded through both _call_logged (PATH A for _paged_search calls) and direct _with_connection_retry calls (PATH B for per-issue fetches) to reach all high-volume read sites
All mutation operations must fail immediately on 429 without retry, defaulting rate_limit_retry to False across all three layers to prevent silent inheritance by future callers
Cap exhaustion must raise BackendHTTPError with code 429 at the adapter boundary, never leaking the vendor JIRAError type
Retry-After parsing must reuse existing _errors.parse_retry_after() and MAX_BACKOFF_S constant rather than implementing a second parser
Four specific read call sites must opt into rate-limit retry: get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map's _paged_search, get_comment_map's per-issue fetch, and get_parent_map
